```{r}

options(scipen=999)

# Install package and load library:
install.packages("ggwordcloud")
library(ggwordcloud)
library(tidyverse)

# Read in data:
d <- read.csv('../data/raw/wc_tokens.csv')
d_concrete <- read.csv('../data/raw/concreteness_ratings_knowledge_corr.csv')

# Select distinct feature and concreteness ratings:
d_concrete <- d_concrete %>%
  select(feature, concreteness) %>%
  distinct()

# Join ratings with word correlation data set:
d <- inner_join(d, d_concrete, on='feature')

# Order data and take top 100 frequencies for cloud:
d_sorted <- d[order(d$rel_freq, decreasing=TRUE), ]
d_wc <- d_sorted[1:50,]

d_wc <- d_wc %>%
  mutate(rel_freq_sqrt = rel_freq**0.5,
         above_median_src_attr = ifelse(know >= median(know), 1, 0))
```


```{r}

# Set seed for cloud:
set.seed(42)

facet_labels <- c('1' = 'Above Median Knowledge of Source', '0' = 'Below Median Knowledge of Source')

# Plot:
ggplot(
  d_wc,
  aes(
    label = feature, size = rel_freq_sqrt,
    x = rel_freq_sqrt, color = know
  )
) +
  facet_wrap(~above_median_src_attr, labeller = as_labeller(facet_labels)) +
  geom_text_wordcloud_area(show.legend=TRUE, area_corr = TRUE) +
  scale_x_discrete(breaks = NULL) +
  scale_colour_gradient(low = "red", high = "blue") +
  labs(colour='Source Attribution of Emotion', size='Relative Frequency', x='Source Attribution Knowledge Word Cloud') +
  scale_radius(range = c(0, 11), limits = c(0, NA)) +
  theme_minimal()

# Save:
ggsave('figures/ggwordcloud_know_50_facet.jpg')

```

```{r}
# Set seed for cloud:
set.seed(42)

# Plot:
ggplot(
  d_wc,
  aes(
    label = feature, size = abs(corr_know),
    x = rel_freq, color = rel_freq
  )
) +
  geom_text_wordcloud_area(show.legend=TRUE) +
  scale_x_discrete(breaks = NULL) +
  facet_wrap(~is_pos_corr) +
  scale_color_gradient() +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 4) +
  labs(colour='Relative Frequency', size='Strength of Correlation', x='Source Attribution Knowledge Word Cloud') +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave('figures/ggwordcloud_abs_corr.jpg')
```

```{r}
# Set seed for cloud:
set.seed(42)

facet_labels <- c('negative'='Negative Association', 'positive'='Positive Association')

d_wc_neg <- d_wc %>%
  filter(is_pos_corr == 'negative')

# Plot:
ggplot(
  d_wc,
  aes(
    label = feature, size = concreteness,
    x = rel_freq, color = corr_know
  )
) +
  geom_text_wordcloud_area(show.legend=TRUE) +
  scale_x_discrete(breaks = NULL) +
  facet_wrap(~is_pos_corr, labeller=as_labeller(facet_labels)) +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 4) +
  scale_color_gradient2(low="red", high="blue") +
  labs(colour='Correlation With Knowledge', size='Concreteness Rating', x='Source Attribution Knowledge Correlation/Concreteness Rating Word Cloud') +
  theme_minimal()

# Save:
ggsave('figures/ggwordcloud_concreteness_v1.jpg')
```
